test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_loss_economics.py tests/test_phase5_daily_results.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/paper/loss_economics.py src/financial_brain/paper/daily_results.py tests/test_loss_economics.py

implemented: Separates gross-negative, positive-gross cost-erased, net-positive, and gross-flat trades.
Reports counts, gross/cost/net INR, notional, notional share, and aggregate notional-weighted basis-point rates.
Rejects invalid notional, negative expenses, duplicate trade identifiers, nonfinite values, and gross/cost/net reconciliation errors.
Displays the categories in the daily paper report separately for each evidence mode.
scope_limits: The report covers closed trades supplied by the paper ledger; open positions are not included.
This accounting classification does not establish that a strategy is profitable or that costs are avoidable.
